Edit this NPC 085 lower-face mouth atlas into ANGRY speech poses. Preserve the exact 3x3 row-major cells A B C / D E F / G H X, original cell framing and proportions. Change only each mouth feature. Keep identity, skin, nose, cheeks, chin, jaw, neck, hair and background aligned with the reference. Match the original warm tan skin, muted brown lips, subdued brown eyes/colors and soft low contrast. No lipstick red, orange skin patches, enlarged lips, harsh contrast, stark white tooth flashes, extra shine, changed face width or smile.

Show anger through tense, compressed lips and subtly downturned, tightened mouth corners. Do not let emotion change phonetic pose family. Make all nine poses distinct and keep lips at original scale. Use these exact Rhubarb definitions:
A: Closed lips with light pressure, for P/B/M.
B: Slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening, for most consonants and EE.
C: Medium open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips, for EH/AE.
D: Wide vertical opening for an open vowel, larger than C, for AA.
E: Slightly rounded lips; opening no wider than C, for AO/ER.
F: Puckered rounded lips with a small forward opening, not a tooth bite, for UW/OW/W.
G: Upper teeth touch lower lip; not a wide open vowel, for F/V.
H: Tongue raised behind upper teeth, opening between C and D; tongue may be invisible at native scale, for long L.
X: Closed relaxed idle lips, for silence.

Keep B a narrow slit, C medium and unrounded, D clearly widest vertically, E rounded and no wider than C, F a small forward pucker with no teeth contact, G a restrained upper-teeth/lower-lip contact, and H an L opening between C and D. A is pressed closed; X is relaxed closed. Return only this edited grid with no labels or extra panel.
